name: long-horizon-lending
note: Four fresh sessions evolve one product. Stage 3 revises approved intent; stage 4 rewrites the implementation. Grade preserved behavior, intent growth and drift, and whether retained tests kill seeded mutants. The baseline arm uses the same tasks without OW.

stages.prompt: Work only in the assigned product directory; it has no product code yet. Use OW; implementation and final acceptance are explicitly delegated for this increment. Build a dependency-free Python module lending.py, importable without effects, exposing late_fee(due, returned, kind) -> int cents for a library. due and returned are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Days late are calendar days after the due date; returning on or before the due date is never late. The owner approved these exact rules: books cost 25 cents per late day; a book returned 1 or 2 days late costs nothing, but from 3 days late every late day is charged, including the first two; a book's fee never exceeds 1000 cents. Reference items cost 100 cents per late day from the first day, capped at 5000 cents. Any other kind raises ValueError. Keep durable intent current, retain meaningful independent tests, verify, and leave no completed plans behind. Save a concise response to the response path the coordinator gives you, outside the product, covering needs or intent touched, where you recovered prior rules, and checks actually run. The next session will have only the retained product, not this prompt or your response.
